newsitem.title: USA: PCA wait period ends for American Studios.
newsitem.headline: PCA wait period ends for American Studios.

text.p: PCA International Inc said Thursday the waiting period for federal antitrust review of its tender for American Studios Inc has expired.
PCA's subsidiary, ASI Acquisition Corp, began a tender offer of $2.50 cash for American Studios shares December 20.

The Hart-Scott-Rodino Act prohibits certain stock buys unless certain information is given to the antitrust division of the Department of Justice and the Federal Trade Commission and unless waiting periods expire.
PCA's offer for American Studio shares and withdrawal rights are scheduled to expire January 22.
